_comment: ProGramerly integrated tools manifest. Antwerp Designs | Ionity (Pty) Ltd | AEDI - Policy 986 AED. These executables are capabilities of ProGramerly, not separate products: they ship inside the Windows installer only. Every file is pinned by byte size and SHA-256; src/main/services/programs.js refuses to launch anything that does not match, and scripts/check-programs.js verifies the payload folder against this list before a build. The payload itself lives in a PRIVATE repository and is never offered for independent download.

programs.name: Fan control
programs.desc: Fan curves and cooling control for this workstation - the Ionity FanControl build, opened from the Hardware workspace.

programs.name: AiOS layout
programs.desc: The IONITY AiOS operator layout - the reference shell the Command Center and its controls follow.

programs.name: MCP audit
programs.desc: Internal MCP server security audit tool. Side tool for maintainers; runs as an installer and asks first.
